title: Do Language Models Feel the Sentiment? Investigating Emotion Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.13744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emotion vectors are directions in a language model's internal representations that are associated with emotional concepts. Prior work shows that these vectors can influence model behavior, but their role in sentiment classification remains unclear. This study investigates emotion directions in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Eight directions extracted from GoEmotions are evaluated through sentiment probing, activation interventions, and supervised correction. Emotion-only probes achieve 88.66% and 90.70% accuracy on binary TweetEval. In exploratory matched-ablation experiments, raw emotion-space removal causes 2.39 and 1.10 percentage points more accuracy loss than matched isotropic random-subspace removal for 0.5B and 3B, respectively. translated_title: 语言模型能感受情感吗？探索情绪向量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.13744v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：情绪向量是语言模型内部表示中与情感概念相关联的方向。先前的研究表明，这些向量能够影响模型行为，但它们在情感分类中的作用仍不清楚。本研究对 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 中的情绪方向进行了探究。从 GoEmotions 数据集中提取的八个方向通过情感探测、激活干预和监督校正进行评估。仅使用情绪特征的探测器在二分类 TweetEval 任务上分别达到 88.66% 和 90.70% 的准确率。在探索性的匹配消融实验中，对于 0.5B 和 3B 模型，移除原始情绪空间分别比移除匹配的各向同性随机子空间多造成 2.39 和 1.10 个百分点的准确率损失。经过八次比较的 Holm 校正后，TweetEval 上的全部四个原始效应和去噪效应均保持显著。一项探索性的 SST-2 扩展实验显示，原始超额损失较小，分别为 0.66 和 0.57 个百分点。
tldr: 本研究在 Qwen2.5 模型的内部表示中定位了与情感概念对应的情绪向量方向，并通过情感探测和匹配消融实验证实了这些方向确实编码了情感信息，移除它们会显著降低模型的情感分类准确率。
en_tdlr: This study localizes emotion vector directions in the internal representations of Qwen2.5 models and demonstrates through sentiment probing and matched ablation experiments that these directions genuinely encode sentiment information, with their removal significantly degrading sentiment classification accuracy.
